# Shaun Porwal

> Personal site of Shaun Porwal: software and machine learning engineer working across AI agent systems, biomedical data science and chemical inventory. Currently Founder & Engineer at Junto Technologies.

## Pages

- [Shaun Porwal](https://www.shaunporwal.com/): Shaun Porwal is a software and machine learning engineer. Notes on building, coding and thinking clearly.
- [About — Shaun Porwal](https://www.shaunporwal.com/about.html): About Shaun Porwal — engineer working across AI/ML, biomedical data science, and chemical inventory.
- [Stuff — Shaun Porwal](https://www.shaunporwal.com/stuff.html): Odds and ends from Shaun Porwal, including an iPhone macro photo of an eye.
- [Shaun Porwal — Resume](https://www.shaunporwal.com/resume.html): Shaun Porwal's resume: software engineering, machine learning, and biomedical data science experience.

## Work

- [Junto Technologies](https://juntotechnologies.com/): My company. It modernizes chemistry labs.
- [ChemInventory](https://cheminventory.co/): Chemical inventory, orders and batch documents.
- [Bench Bridge](https://bench-bridge.juntotechnologies.com/): A demo of older lab instruments feeding a lab system.
- [dcurves](https://github.com/MSKCC-Epi-Bio/dcurves): Decision curve analysis in Python. I created it at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center.
